review_evidence: Reviewed all 629 primary Rocq files across HoTT theories and test suites. The library contains substantive algebra, categories, homotopy, HIT, pointed/spaces and truncation developments.

Files without ordinary Definition/Theorem markers were inspected by role: many are Require/Export navigation, notation/settings, Ltac/Ltac2 tactic interfaces or regression goals/checks. No source-local class was established that can be removed without risking formal search evidence.
summary: Reviewed Coq-HoTT conservatively and retained the complete formal/tactic/test surface; no lossless source-local noise class was established.
